remarks: You can stroll into town from 40 Oenoke Ridge, one of New Canaan's most admired and iconic properties, stunningly transformed by its current owners into a showpiece of refined elegance and contemporary comfort. Nestled on 2+ acres of breathtaking, park-like grounds, this distinguished 1929 brick Colonial offers the rare combination of historic charm and today's most desired luxuries. Boasting 6/7 bedrooms and a full top-to-bottom renovation, this residence is truly turn-key and magazine-worthy. Every inch of this home has been thoughtfully reimagined with impeccable attention to detail combining classic architecture and sophisticated style. An entertainer's dream, the home features multiple outdoor living and lounging areas. The newly installed gated entrance offers privacy and an impressive welcome, setting the tone for what lies beyond. Perfectly located just steps from the heart of town, yet tucked into its own private oasis, 40 Oenoke Ridge delivers the best of both worlds-vibrant in-town living and the tranquility of a serene estate.
